run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-16T13:52:35Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: Prometheus in namespace prometheus is running and Ready, but this cluster contains no Alertmanager workload at all, so Prometheus has no alerting target to notify and its own rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers is firing. The rule is configured in configmap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, severity warning — i.e. it fires on zero *discovered* Alertmanager targets, not on send errors. Cluster-wide there is no Alertmanager StatefulSet (only 6 StatefulSets exist, none of them Alertmanager), no Alertmanager Deployment (the 36 Deployments include only prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and prometheus-kube-state-metrics in the prometheus namespace), no pod running an alertmanager image among the 66 pods, no Service exposing 9093 other than the unrelated kafka controller port in otel-demo, and no Alertmanager ServiceAccount in namespace prometheus (only 5, none Alertmanager). The alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com CRD is installed, so the missing piece is the Alertmanager instance/CR itself, not the API. Prometheus-side infrastructure is healthy and is therefore counter-evidence against crash, OOM, node pressure or operator outage: pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Ready with restartCount 0 and no previous container, all 5 nodes are Ready with no pressure conditions, and the operator pod/deployment are Ready. Affected: Prometheus's alert-delivery path (its own alerting signal). Changed during the window without an established cause: the Prometheus pod was created at 2026-11-16T13:52:03Z while its siblings date from 2026-11-15T14:38:34Z and the StatefulSet owner is unchanged (generation 1, currentRevision = updateRevision) — the pod was recreated without a workload update, and its trigger is unknown; it is not evidence of the missing Alertmanager. Unverified: the actual value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered (Prometheus self-metrics are not exposed by the queryable data source), the Prometheus config Secret, all container logs (0 bytes returned), whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists that the operator failed to materialize, and any downstream alert-delivery impact.

claims.text: The alerting rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers is configured in configmap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 (namespace prometheus) with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, severity warning, summary 'Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.'

Cluster-wide there are 6 StatefulSets (chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder, topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus); none is an Alertmanager. The only StatefulSet in namespace prometheus is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus with 1/1 ready replicas.

Cluster-wide there are 36 Deployments; namespace prometheus contains only prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (readyReplicas 1, image prometheus-operator:v0.85.0) and prometheus-kube-state-metrics (readyReplicas 1, image kube-state-metrics:v2.17.0). No Alertmanager Deployment exists anywhere.
Across all 66 pods in the cluster, no pod runs a container image whose name contains "alertmanager" (the filtered projection returned an empty array).

Across all 52 Services in the cluster, the only Service exposing port 9093 (Alertmanager's default port) is Service kafka in namespace otel-demo (kafka controller port); in namespace prometheus the Services are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (9090 http-web plus reloader-web 8080), prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter — none named or templated for Alertmanager.

Namespace prometheus has exactly 5 ServiceAccounts (default, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter); there is no Alertmanager service account, which a deployed Alertmanager would require.

The monitoring.coreos.com CustomResourceDefinitions are installed, including alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (v1), prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com (v1), alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com (v1alpha1) and prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com (v1), so a missing Alertmanager API/CRD is not the blocker.

Namespace prometheus contains exactly two ConfigMaps: kube-root-ca.crt and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0; the latter's keys are generated rule files (prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml, otel-demo alerting and workload-recording rules, k8s/prometheus recording rules). No Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap is present in the namespace.

Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running and Ready with restartCount 0 in both containers (prometheus, config-reloader) and an empty lastState, all pod conditions True (PodReadyToStartContainers, Initialized, Ready, ContainersReady, PodScheduled), owned by StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.

Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was created at 2026-11-16T13:52:03Z (startTime identical) and is scheduled on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a, while the operator, kube-state-metrics and node-exporter pods of the same namespace were created at 2026-11-15T14:38:34Z.

StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has generation 1, observedGeneration 1, currentRevision = updateRevision = prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59, replicas 1 and readyReplicas 1, and was created 2026-11-15T14:38:35Z — i.e. the pod was recreated at 13:52:03Z without any StatefulSet spec/revision change.
All 5 nodes report Ready=True and no other condition True (no MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure), including node i-0bc0544469bfef13a which hosts the Prometheus pod.

The queryable Prometheus data source holds only otel-demo trace-derived series for the selector {__name__=~"kube_.*|traces_.*"}: traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket. kube-state-metrics series and Prometheus self-metrics were not among the returned metric names.

Primary cause: Prometheus's effective alerting configuration has no Alertmanager target because no Alertmanager instance is deployed in this cluster, so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stayed at 0 and the rule fired after its 10m for-period. The deepest cause reachable from this evidence is that absence: no Alertmanager StatefulSet/Deployment/pod image/Service on 9093/ServiceAccount exists cluster-wide, while the Alertmanager CRD is installed and the Prometheus/operator/node objects that would host it are healthy. The 'discovered = 0' reading is inferred from the rule expression because the metric itself is not exposed here.

Because the rule has for: 10m and the alert started at 2026-11-16T13:52:35Z, the 'discovered < 1' condition most plausibly held from about 13:42:35Z, i.e. before the current Prometheus pod started at 13:52:03Z; this suggests the Alertmanager absence predates that pod recreation (Prometheus persists active-alert for-state in its TSDB across restarts). This is an inference from the rule expression and observed timestamps, not a measured metric value.

Rejected: Prometheus itself is crashing, not ready or being OOM-killed, so its notifier could not run. The pod is Running/Ready with restartCount 0, no previous container instance, no OOMKilled/Evicted marks, and runs on a Ready node with no pressure conditions.

Rejected: an Alertmanager is deployed but unhealthy or unreachable from Prometheus. No Alertmanager workload, alertmanager container image, Service on port 9093 or Alertmanager ServiceAccount exists anywhere in the cluster, so there is nothing to be unreachable; moreover the firing rule measures *discovered* Alertmanager targets (< 1), which an unreachable-but-configured Alertmanager would not trigger (that case raises the error-rate rules instead).
Rejected: an infrastructure failure (node NotReady or node pressure) broke the alerting path. All five nodes report Ready=True with no MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure condition.

Rejected as the cause of this alert (though this recreation is a real change in the window): the recreation of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 at 2026-11-16T13:52:03Z explains the firing. The pod carries no crash evidence (restartCount 0, no previous container) and its StatefulSet was not updated (generation 1, currentRevision = updateRevision), so this is a pod-level (re)creation whose trigger is unknown, not a Prometheus fault that would remove Alertmanager targets — no Alertmanager exists in the cluster independently of this pod.

Counter-evidence against a prometheus-operator outage or crash as the cause: pod prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh is Running/Ready with restartCount 0 and no previous container instance, and its Deployment prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator reports readyReplicas 1. This confirms the operator object is up, but does not prove it reconciled an Alertmanager custom resource, since its logs were unreadable.

No config-reload or Alertmanager-connection log line could be checked, so log-level evidence of 'no alertmanagers configured' is absent rather than negative.

Endpoints named or containing an alertmanager (view de577720-907e-42ca-97c7-094d9f0bfeae-t0:99e9f41d-ac55-4561-8646-48eac181f306) and NetworkPolicies in namespace prometheus (view de577720-907e-42ca-97c7-094d9f0bfeae-t1:51b5d407-cb14-498f-bfa3-b8fb58ffe072) returned no_data, so a network-level block toward any Alertmanager cannot be excluded from this data.

Alertmanager custom resources (monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Alertmanager) cannot be listed with the available tools, so it is unverified whether an Alertmanager CR exists that the operator failed to materialize into a StatefulSet/Service/ServiceAccount; the observed absence of those derived objects is the evidence used.

Cluster events were only available for 2026-11-16T13:59:55Z to 14:32:41Z, and the filtered all-namespace event search returned no_data (view 1ab60716-bb0e-4271-bc96-7805d866c6c-t1:7c630471-09c7-4832-9deb-51eee0be6c18 as delivered: 1ab60716-bb0e-4271-bc96-b7805d866c6c-t1:7c630471-09c7-4832-9deb-51eee0be6c18); nothing is known about why pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 2026-11-16T13:52:03Z, and no eviction or OOM evidence was observed.

No change-history integration is available, so whether an Alertmanager instance or the kube-prometheus-stack values ever included Alertmanager before or during the window is unknown; the cluster state proves only the current absence.
Downstream impact — which alerts were never delivered because no Alertmanager exists — is unverified; no notification or delivery metrics were readable.
next_steps: Inspect the kube-prometheus-stack release values and the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus (spec.alerting.alertmanagers / alertmanagerConfigs) to confirm no Alertmanager is referenced; this was not readable here.

If centralized alerting is intended, deploy the Alertmanager component (Alertmanager CR plus its ServiceAccount/Service) and verify that Prometheus reports prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered >= 1 for job prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and that PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers clears.
If alerting should go to an Alertmanager outside this cluster, add that endpoint to the Prometheus resource's alerting.alertmanagers and confirm discovered targets reach 1.

Decide whether this alert should be silenced or suppressed for stacks where Alertmanager is intentionally disabled, since the condition will otherwise persist indefinitely and mask real notification outages.

Investigate separately why prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 2026-11-16T13:52:03Z (node i-0bc0544469bfef13a kubelet events or a manual deletion around that time), since the StatefulSet revision did not change.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null).
